stations.title: Top folder
stations.text: Orders, artwork and invoices. Nothing else.

captions: At Ashgrove, Idris wants places for receipts, orders by month, ideas and a print queue.
Today the top folder has nowhere to put any of it.
You make the folders and one empty file, in four tasks.
Receipts have a home, the months are ready, and the print queue waits.
Nothing moved yet, but every file now has somewhere to go.
